meta.title: Fix issue #2798: Remove duplicate tool results in messages
meta.body_summary: Remove duplicate appending of tool results to messages in agent_utils.py to reduce token usage and latency; adds a unit test to verify no duplication.

perf_labels.notes: Devin removed duplicate tool result append; AI crew review approved with minor suggestions; closed by bot after 7 days inactivity without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 118 changed lines, this is a small, focused bug fix. The PR was closed without merge due to inactivity, which is unusual for such a low-risk change; an AI-powered review recommended approval but no human reviewer took final action before the Devin auto-close timer triggered.

review_details.concern_detail: AI-powered review crew (posted by joaomdmoura) provided a detailed approval with non-blocking suggestions for type hints, parameterized tests, edge case tests, and an explanatory comment. No human maintainer provided feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Removing duplicate tool results from messages reduces token usage and latency.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: duplicate_message_append (prior code appended tool results twice, causing token bloat)
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed due to Devin bot's 7-day inactivity timer despite a positive AI review. No human merge action occurred.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A trivial 2-line fix with a supporting test faced no technical blocker. Closure resulted from a process gap: the PR lacked timely human reviewer engagement and exceeded Devin's auto-close window.

detection_detail.code_reading: joaomdmoura's AI-powered review crew performed a static code review, noting style and testing improvements. No human maintainer directly examined the performance claim or tested the change.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or quantitative performance data was provided or requested. Only qualitative description of token bloat.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The PR was closed without any performance validation or regression testing by maintainers.

core_change_summary.description: In agent_utils.py, removed the line that appended tool_result.result to messages, preventing duplicate message entries. Added test_tool_result_duplication.py with a unit test mocking tools and asserting the result appears at most once in the messages array.
change_trajectory: Initial commit removes duplicate append (2 lines deleted).
Added test file with 77 lines initially.
Subsequent commits iterate on test: add type hints, fix CrewAgentExecutor initialization, adjust import sorting (ruff), add explanatory comment to agent_utils.py.
Final commit fixes ToolResult parameters in test.
